title: Neow Companions
description:
Choose a companion after Neow's starting relic.

Neow Companions adds a growing pool of companion relics based on Slay the Spire 2 creatures and bosses. Each companion has a combat pet, relic icon, custom card, card art, and themed animation triggers.

Current companion pool:
Byrdpip, Soul Fysh Pip, Wriggler, Ceremonial Beast, Kin Follower, Eye With Teeth, Gremlin Merc, Thieving Hopper, Aeonglass, Lagavulin Matriarch, The Kin, Waterfall Giant, Vantom, Knowledge Demon, The Insatiable, Queen, Test Subject, Seapunk, Shrinker Beetle, Operosis, The Architect, Rustclad, Shadeleaf, Glitchling, Bonebinder, Gilded Page, Ember Pip, Frost Pip, Storm Pip, Thorn Pip, and Kaiser Crab.

Recent highlights:
- Added Kaiser Crab as a full-size background companion with draggable arms and Royal Broadside, a Power that bombards all enemies at the start of each turn.
- Updated several relic icons to use cleaner transparent cutouts and refreshed the Workshop thumbnail.
- Added Ember, Frost, Storm, and Thorn Pip companions using Byrdpip-style pets, Byrd Swoop card art, elemental cards, and new bird portrait relic icons.
- Added mod settings to offer companions at every Ancient encounter and to choose multiple companions from one Ancient screen.
- When you have multiple companions, normal player attack cards now trigger one random companion animation instead of every companion attacking in sequence.
- Added right-click dragging for companion pets so you can reposition them during combat.
- Added proper icons for custom companion powers instead of the base missing "NOPE" icon.
- Tuned Ceremonial Beast animation behavior: Ceremonial Toll uses its charge, while normal player attacks use the regular attack animation.
- Added Shadeleaf, Glitchling, Bonebinder, and Gilded Page companions with character-based hue swaps, dialogue barks, cards, relic art, and card art.
- Added Rustclad companion with Buff Up, a 0-cost skill that costs HP and grants temporary Strength.
- Added The Architect companion with a Grand Design card that generates random companion cards.
- Added screenshot-based Architect relic and card art from the real in-game Architect model.
- Added Seapunk, Shrinker Beetle, and Operosis companions.
- Added mod settings for showing all companion choices, granting a random companion with no choices, and disabling companion card grants.
- Improved card preview values for damage, block, summon, and Osty damage where buffs, debuffs, Dexterity, Vulnerable, Weak, and related modifiers apply.
- Added and tuned companion animations, including Insatiable devour, Waterfall Giant explosion, Seapunk multi-kick, Shrinker Beetle cast/splash, Knowledge Demon buffing, Kin bomb/attack behavior, and Operosis/Osty summon attacks.
- Fixed multiplayer desyncs caused by unseeded random companion/card/target choices.

Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: Replaced paged companion choices with a scrollable list. Companions now remember their dragged position and size between combats; hold right-click to drag and use the mouse wheel to resize. Only one companion can be dragged at a time. Updated elemental Byrd Pip relic icons using color-shaded authentic in-game Byrd Pip artwork. No AI-generated art.
